_doc: DISTRIBUTION ENVELOPE MANIFEST (epistemic prevention, wave EP-1).
One canonical home for every derived rate/count bound in the estate. A test reads
instead of hardcoding an integer, so a bound and its provenance can never drift
apart. tests/lint/distributionEnvelopePower.test.js re-derives every entry from its
measured base rate and reds if the registered bound, the margin, or the provenance
Entry schema: id, file, n, baseRate, baseMeasuredAt, baseMeasurementN (>= 400),
loosenPending=true means the DERIVED bound is looser than the live one. The live
(tighter) bound stays in force and the derivation goes to the owner queue — program
law: never loosen a bound silently.
The TOTALITY ROSTER — which distribution-shaped test files owe an entry here — lives
in tests/lint/distributionEnvelopePower.test.js as a frozen, shrink-only literal, not
in this file. Rows there start pendingMigration and retire as wave EP-2D measures each
base rate and registers the derivation below. This file starts empty by design.

entries.measurementContext: minifold claude/composite-r4 d0fdcf7c, live tree carrying unrelated foreign dirt (none in this instrument's path)
entries.notes: 1/400 ordinary cities read corrupted at birth. THIN BASE: a single observed event, so alpha is set to 1e-4 rather than the program default 1e-3 — the extra decade of budget is a hedge on the base rate itself, not on the corpus (which is seeded and fixed). At 1e-3 the derivation is 6. The authored ceiling was Math.round(400*0.025)=10, shared with the town and village sweeps; adopting 7 tightens it.

entries.measurementContext: minifold claude/composite-r4 d0fdcf7c, live tree carrying unrelated foreign dirt (none in this instrument's path)
entries.notes: THE TRIGGER INSTRUMENT of the epistemic-prevention program. 27/400 = 6.75% of 90-criminal-priority towns reach full capture. The live ceiling 40 (Math.round(400*0.1)) is KEPT: the alpha-1e-3 envelope derives 45, which is LOOSER, and program law forbids an agent loosening a bound. Not a defect — 40 carries 2.59 sigma and is EXACTLY the alpha-1e-2 derivation, so the loosening is a strictness choice for the owner, not a repair. Owner ruling wanted: keep 40 (1% budget) or adopt 45 (0.1% budget).

entries.measurementContext: minifold claude/composite-r4 d0fdcf7c, live tree carrying unrelated foreign dirt (none in this instrument's path)
entries.notes: 15/400 = 3.75% of 90-criminal-priority cities reach full capture (the file header's older ~4.0% figure was 16/400). The authored ceiling was the SAME expression as the town sweep, Math.round(400*0.1)=40, which left the city bound 6.58 sigma out — loose by accident, because one expression was serving two different rates. Separated and tightened to 29.

entries.measurementContext: minifold claude/composite-r4 d0fdcf7c, live tree carrying unrelated foreign dirt (none in this instrument's path)
entries.notes: 397/400 criminal-heavy cities read equilibrium or worse. THIN BASE in the informative tail (3 non-events), so alpha is 1e-4 rather than 1e-3 (which derives 389). The authored floor was Math.round(400*0.5)=200 — 114 sigma below the mean, a floor that could only red if the mechanism were deleted outright. The town half of the same assertion measures 400/400 and is degenerate: it keeps its authored 50% floor un-derived.

entries.measurementContext: minifold claude/composite-r4 d0fdcf7c, live tree carrying unrelated foreign dirt (none in this instrument's path)
entries.notes: genRelNarrative emits a phrasing for 229/400 seeds of the `relationship-grammar-${i}` family (57.25%). The pre-migration floor was a hand-picked `> 40` sitting 8.1 sigma BELOW the mean of 91.6 — it could only have reddened if emission collapsed by more than half. The derived floor 71 keeps 3.29 sigma of power; the test's own 160-draw corpus measures 87.

entries.measurementContext: minifold claude/composite-r4 3aa08f1d, live tree carrying unrelated foreign dirt (none in this instrument's path)
entries.notes: The unwalled baseline arm of the walls-suppress-sieges paired comparison: siege-family stress types summed over 120 unwalled `siege-${i}` runs. Measured 62/400 on the extended family (15.5%) against 21/120 on the test's OWN corpus (17.5%) — 0.61 sigma apart, so no corpus/family divergence here (contrast the `envelope-${i}` corner, 4/50 vs 89/400). The live floor 10 is KEPT: the alpha-1e-3 envelope derives 6, which is LOOSER, and program law forbids an agent loosening a bound. Not a defect — 10 still carries 2.17 sigma. Owner ruling wanted: keep 10 or adopt 6. Two side notes. (1) The file header's comment claimed 'empirically 18' unwalled sieges; the current measurement is 21, a stale comment rather than a bound failure, refreshed at the assertion. (2) This arm is mildly OVERDISPERSED relative to a Bernoulli — two of 400 seeds carry two siege types (distribution 0:340 1:58 2:2) — so a derived bound would be optimistically tight. Harmless here precisely because the derivation is the looser side and is not adopted.

entries.measurementContext: minifold claude/composite-r4 3aa08f1d, live tree carrying unrelated foreign dirt (none in this instrument's path)
entries.notes: The walled arm of the same paired comparison: 23/400 (5.75%) on the extended family, 6/120 (5.00%) on the test's own corpus — no divergence. This is a NEW ABSOLUTE ceiling, added ALONGSIDE the pre-existing RELATIVE assertion (walledSieges <= floor(unwalledSieges * 0.7)), which is kept rather than replaced: the ratio is blind to both arms inflating together, and this envelope is blind to a suppression collapse that scales both, so they red on different worlds. Assertion count goes up, never down. The walled arm is exactly Bernoulli per seed (0:377 1:23 at N=400), so the binomial model is exact on this entry.

entries.measurementContext: minifold claude/composite-r4 3aa08f1d, live tree carrying unrelated foreign dirt (none in this instrument's path)
entries.notes: Anti-vacuity floor on the opt-in ancient-ruin mint rate: at least one seed of the sweep must mint, or the whole body of per-mint assertions above it is vacuous. Measured 43/400 on the `anc-${i}` family (10.75%); per-block-of-40 counts are 5,6,4,1,4,4,3,6,3,7, and the test's own first-80 block measures 11 (13.75%, 0.87 sigma high) — no divergence. THE CORPUS WAS DOUBLED 40 -> 80 TO BUY THIS ENTRY ITS POWER: at the authored N=40 the floor of 1 sits 1.685 sigma from the mean and FAILS the program's 2-sigma gate, and no bound above the vacuous 0 can reach 2 sigma at that N (the ceiling of the achievable margin there is 2.195, at bound 0). At N=80 the same floor carries 2.743. The alpha-1e-3 derivation is 0, which is vacuous — a count cannot be negative — and looser, so the live floor of 1 stays in force and the derivation is filed rather than adopted. Runtime cost of the doubling: ~135 ms.

entries.measurementContext: minifold claude/composite-r4 3aa08f1d, live tree carrying unrelated foreign dirt (none in this instrument's path)
entries.notes: The 'nowhere near universal' ceiling on the same mint rate — the small-generation-time-chance posture. The authored bound was `minted < 20` over 40 seeds: a rate ceiling of 47.5% against a 10.75% base, 7.5 sigma out. Re-derived on the doubled 80-seed corpus the ceiling is 19 again in COUNT terms, which is a 2x TIGHTENING in RATE terms (23.75% vs 47.5%) and carries 3.754 sigma. The doubling is what makes both sides of this two-sided instrument powered at once; see the floor entry for why N had to move.

entries.measurementContext: minifold claude/composite-r4 3aa08f1d, live tree carrying unrelated foreign dirt (none in this instrument's path)
entries.notes: The 3-year lit soak's journey cadence, expressed as a COUNT of departures over the fixture's 12 NPCs x 3 years = 36 NPC-year trials. The trial unit is exact by the same test's cadence assertion (at most one departure per NPC-year), and the denominator is fixed by the fixture rather than by an outcome, so this needs no fixed-n workaround. Base rate 207/576 = 35.9375%, measured over 16 runs of the identical fixture: the test's literal seed 'roads-3y' plus `roads-3y-${i}`. The test's own seed yields 16/36 (44.4%), 1.06 sigma high — no divergence. The authored floor was perNpcYear > 0.05, i.e. >= 2 departures; the derivation TIGHTENS it to 4. A denominator guard in the test pins 36, so a change to the fixture's NPC roster reds instead of silently re-scaling what this bound means.

entries.measurementContext: minifold claude/composite-r4 3aa08f1d, live tree carrying unrelated foreign dirt (none in this instrument's path)
entries.notes: Ceiling arm of the same cadence band. The authored bound was perNpcYear < 0.9, i.e. <= 32 departures of a possible 36 — 6.6 sigma out, reachable only if nearly every NPC travelled every year. Tightened to 23 (63.9% per NPC-year), 3.495 sigma. A FINDING was recorded alongside this measurement and is NOT a bound failure: the cadence law this same test asserts (<= 1 journey per NPC-year) is VIOLATED on seeds outside the test's single-seed corpus — 5 violations across 16 seeds (roads-3y-7, roads-3y-9, roads-3y-12 twice, roads-3y-13), all on a city seat or envoy, on 'dominion', 'embassy', 'observance' and 'diplomacy' purposes. The test's own seed 'roads-3y' is clean, so the live assertion is green over a corpus of one. Filed for the owner queue; src is out of this program's scope.
